verdict.rationale: GitLab explicitly documents a Linux package designed to 'install GitLab without laborious configuration' and provides scaling/reference architecture docs for self-managed instances, directly matching the story. However, community evidence describes real operational pain (backup/restore failures, performance/reliability issues) once self-managed at scale, undercutting the 'without laborious configuration' promise in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth install experience, and detail on ongoing maintenance/upgrade simplicity beyond initial setup.
